MERGE INTO silver.dim_customer t
USING updates_staged s
ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id AND t.is_current = TRUE
WHEN MATCHED AND t.tier <> s.tier THEN
  UPDATE SET t.is_current = FALSE, t.end_date = s.effective_date;
INSERT INTO silver.dim_customer
SELECT customer_id, tier, effective_date, NULL as end_date, TRUE as is_current
FROM updates_staged;

sparksql:
-- Range join with broadcast quote lookup
SELECT t.ticker, t.trade_time, t.trade_price, q.bid, q.ask
FROM trades t
LEFT JOIN quotes q ON t.ticker = q.ticker
  AND q.quote_time = (
    SELECT MAX(q2.quote_time) FROM quotes q2
    WHERE q2.ticker = t.ticker AND q2.quote_time <= t.trade_time
  );
duckdb:
-- DuckDB native ASOF JOIN
SELECT t.ticker, t.trade_time, t.price, q.bid, q.ask
FROM trades t
ASOF JOIN quotes q
  ON t.ticker = q.ticker
 AND t.trade_time >= q.quote_time;
snowflake:
-- Snowflake ASOF JOIN
SELECT t.ticker, t.trade_time, t.price, q.bid, q.ask
FROM trades t
ASOF JOIN quotes q
  MATCH_CONDITION (t.trade_time >= q.quote_time)
  ON t.ticker = q.ticker;

  WHERE q.ticker = t.ticker AND q.ts <= t.ts

# Polars schema evolution with diagonal concatenation
import polars as pl
df_base = pl.DataFrame({"id": [1, 2], "val": [10, 20]})
df_new = pl.DataFrame({"id": [3], "val": [30], "new_col": ["active"]})
# Diagonal concat automatically handles missing columns with nulls
df_evolved = pl.concat([df_base, df_new], how="diagonal")

# Auto-merge new columns on write

   .mode("append")
   .option("mergeSchema", "true")
   .saveAsTable("silver.customers"))

# PySpark Delta Structured Streaming with foreachBatch micro-batch merge
def upsert_to_delta(micro_df, batch_id):
    (DeltaTable.forName(spark, "silver.iot_readings")
     .alias("t")
     .merge(micro_df.alias("s"), "t.device_id = s.device_id AND t.ts = s.ts")
     .whenMatchedUpdateAll()
     .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
     .execute())

(spark.readStream.table("bronze.raw_iot")
 .writeStream
 .format("delta")
 .foreachBatch(upsert_to_delta)
 .option("checkpointLocation", "s3://chk/iot_silver")
 .start())
